item.title: Queer Desire and Female Friendship in Simone de Beauvoir’s The Inseparables
item.description: 'The Inseparables' becomes a fertile ground to dig for resonances of ambiguity and ambivalence between queer friendships, lesbian and/or asexual romances, and platonic love affairs.
